description: Connects a domain to DartPanel (https://dartpanel.com) by CNAME: the website or online store at the name itself, its www name, and optionally a reseller's client area on a subdomain the reseller chooses. All records point to panels.dartpanel.com.
variableDescription: portal: the label of the reseller's client area beside its store (for example clientarea), chosen by the reseller in DartPanel
